title: IT Recruiter
description:
About ThinkSmartStaff

ThinkSmartStaff is a US IT staffing company working with prime vendors and direct clients across the US. We source and submit candidates for IT contract roles — software, cloud, data, QA, and DevOps — and we win on speed and quality: fast, accurate submissions, honest candidate screening, and clear communication at every step.

We're building a small, sharp recruiting team from day one, just recruiters who can find the right person, fast.

What You'll Do

* Work on live US IT requirements from prime vendors and clients — primarily contract roles across the US
* Source candidates using Dice, Monster, CareerBuilder, LinkedIn, Indeed, and internal databases
* Use Boolean search, job portals, and headhunting to find matching profiles quickly
* Screen candidates for skills, experience, location, work authorization, and rate expectations
* Conduct initial phone/video screening and assess communication, availability, and genuine interest
* Submit well-matched profiles within 24 hours of receiving a requirement
* Coordinate interviews, follow up with candidates and vendors, and manage feedback loops
* Negotiate rates within the given band and help close candidates
* Maintain accurate records in the ATS / tracker — submissions, interviews, offers, and closures
* Build and maintain a pipeline of IT professionals across key skills: Java, .NET, Python, React, AWS, Azure, Data Engineering, QA Automation, DevOps, ServiceNow, Salesforce, and more

What We're Looking For

**Must-have:**

* 1–4 years of experience as a US IT recruiter (contract staffing preferred)
* Strong understanding of US IT technologies, roles, and hiring terms — W2, C2C, 1099, Corp-to-Corp
* Hands-on experience with Dice, Monster, LinkedIn Recruiter, and job boards
* Strong Boolean search skills and ability to judge resumes quickly and accurately
* Excellent spoken and written English, with confidence speaking to US candidates
* Ability to work US EST hours and manage multiple requirements at once
* Target-driven mindset — you care about submissions, interviews, and closures, not just activity

**Good to have:**

* Experience working with prime vendors / MSP / VMS models
* Experience with ATS tools like JobDiva, Bullhorn, Ceipal, or similar
* Existing database / network of IT candidates in the US
* Understanding of US work authorizations: US Citizen, Green Card, H1B, OPT, CPT, TN, etc.
* Experience recruiting for niche skills: Cloud, Data, AI/ML, Cybersecurity, DevOps

What You'll Get

* Work directly on live US IT requirements — no bench, no waiting
* Competitive salary + attractive incentives on every placement
* Remote work, with a focused team and clear targets
* Fast growth — this is an early team, so strong performers will lead the desk
* Learning on the US staffing model end-to-end: vendors, clients, submissions, and closures

How to Apply

Send your updated resume to: **[Apply Email — to confirm]**  
Subject line: US IT Recruiter

Please also mention in your email:

* Years of US IT recruiting experience
* Technologies / roles you have recruited most for
* Current location and notice period
* Expected salary

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:

Joining Bayzat means immersing yourself in an environment of high achievers, tackling complex challenges, and constantly striving for success. Our culture inspires continuous learning and excellence, allowing you to work with and be inspired by some of the brightest minds in the industry.

Our journey to success is anchored in our commitment to innovation, empowering businesses with features designed to optimise efficiency and elevate employee experiences. Whether enhancing people processes, streamlining payments, or enabling smarter decisions, Bayzat is redefining what it means to create a truly remarkable workplace.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for ahands-on Recruiterto own end-to-end hiring delivery for priority roles across the business. This role is execution-focused and outcome-driven, ideal for someone who thrives on sourcing, screening, pipeline management, and disciplined process ownership.

**You will partner closely with Hiring Managers, Recruitment Ops, and the TA Lead to ensure roles move fast, data is clean, and hiring decisions are made on time. This is not a conceptual or employer-branding role; success here is defined by fills, quality, speed, and compliance.**

**Some high-impact responsibilities you will be entrusted with:**

**End-to-End Recruitment Delivery**

* Own the full recruitment lifecycle for assigned roles (intake sourcing screening interviews offer close).
* Drive timely progress across all hiring stages and proactively unblock delays.
* Ensure a consistent, professional candidate experience at every touchpoint.

**Sourcing & Outbound Headhunting**

* Actively source candidates via LinkedIn, referrals, databases, and direct outreach.
* Build and maintain strong shortlists and talent pipelines for recurring or hard-to-fill roles.
* Track sourcing effectiveness and continuously improve outreach quality and response rates.

**Screening & Assessment**

* Conduct structured recruiter screening calls aligned with role requirements and hiring criteria.
* Produce clear, concise, and decision-ready screening notes for hiring managers.
* Apply defined assessment criteria consistently and flag misalignment early.

**Hiring Manager Partnership**

* Run structured intake calls and clarify role scope, priorities, and hiring expectations.
* Follow up relentlessly on feedback, interview availability, and hiring decisions.
* Enforce agreed hiring timelines and process adherence.

**ATS Ownership & Process Discipline**

* Maintain high ATS hygiene: accurate stages, complete data, timely updates.
* Ensure all candidate movement, feedback, and decisions are properly documented.
* Flag process gaps, non-compliance, or recurring bottlenecks to Recruitment Ops / TA Lead.

**Coordination & Execution Excellence**

* Coordinate interviews efficiently with minimal errors or rework.
* Manage candidate communication end-to-end (scheduling, updates, rejections, offers).
* Ensure SLAs, turnaround times, and quality standards are consistently met.

**What you will need to have:**

* 2–4 years of hands-on recruitment experience(in-house or agency).
* Demonstrated experience recruiting remotely across international markets and regions
* Proven ability to source and close candidates through outbound methods.
* Strong screening and candidate evaluation skills.
* High attention to detail and comfort working in structured, process-driven environments.
* Confidence working with ATS systems and recruitment data.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience hiring for Sales, Operations, Tech, or SaaS environments.
* Exposure to high-volume or fast-paced hiring contexts.
* Familiarity with structured interviews and scorecards.
* Hands-on use of AI or automation tools in recruitment(sourcing, screening support, scheduling, or workflow optimization).

**What’s in it for You**

At Bayzat, we don’t sell beanbags or buzzwords as culture - we build an environment where high achievers thrive. You’ll work alongside some of the hungriest, most driven people you’ll ever meet, in a place that rewards performance, not politics.

Here’s what you can expect:

* **Meritocracy at its core:** Your value creation and impact define your growth, not titles or tenure.
* **Freedom to shape your path:** We support cross-functional moves and growth transitions when you drive value.
* **Real feedback culture:** Feedback is coaching - empowering you to find your own answers and elevate your game.
* **Barrier-free collaboration:** Impact matters more than hierarchy. If you can create value, you’ll have a seat at the table - even with the CEO.
* **Accelerated growth:** Fast-track opportunities for top performers; no artificial limits.
* **Flexible work setup:** Remote and hybrid options designed around performance.
* **Inclusive culture:** Regular company-wide all-hands, OKR tribe meetings, and annual awards that celebrate real impact.

This isn’t for everyone — but if you want to be pushed, inspired, and rewarded for what you deliver, **welcome to Bayzat.**

title: Sourcing Partner
description:
ELLKAY started out providing connectivity solutions to laboratories and within a few years, grew to also provide data management solutions to ambulatory organizations. ELLKAY is now a trusted data management partner in five healthcare segments. ELLKAY’s solutions continue to serve laboratories and ambulatory practices and have expanded to empower hospitals and health systems, healthcare IT vendors, ambulatory practices, health plans, and other healthcare organizations with cutting-edge technologies and solutions that drive their growth and interoperability strategies.  
  
Today, ELLKAY remains true to our core values, building strong partner relationships and offering unparalleled service and support while providing innovative, scalable solutions to the challenges our customers face in today’s data-rich world.  
  
ELLKAY's experience, customer-focused approach, and reputation for innovation, speed, and accuracy differentiate ELLKAY as a premier partner for your interoperability needs and data management strategy.  
  
**Job Description:**

ELLKAY is scaling its India-based Talent Acquisition function to support business growth and increasing hiring demand across Engineering and non-engineering teams. The Sourcing Partner is a newly added role designed to bring greater speed, consistency, and velocity to the hiring process. The role will own sourcing and pipeline generation for both TA Partners across technical and non-technical requisitions, supporting hiring across India and the U.S.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership of sourcing coordination, sourcing tools, pipeline data, and reporting. The successful candidate will proactively identify bottlenecks, improve sourcing effectiveness, and deliver clear, reliable recruitment MIS for India. While there are no direct reports today, this role is expected to establish the foundation for a sourcing team as hiring needs grow.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own sourcing and pipeline generation for open technical and non-technical requisitions across India and U.S. teams, aligned with business priorities and hiring targets.
* Partner daily with the TA Partner and Senior TA Partner to clarify requisition priorities, success profiles, sourcing strategies, and pipeline health.
* Run proactive, multi-channel sourcing campaigns using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean/X-ray search, referrals, niche job boards, talent communities, and other relevant tools.
* Build and maintain a searchable candidate database and accurate sourcing trackers, ensuring timely updates across sources, requisitions, and candidate stages.
* Manage external sourcing vendors and agencies: communicate role requirements, track service-level agreements (SLAs), review submissions, and consolidate vendor performance.
* Coordinate candidate screening calls and provide interview scheduling and process support in close partnership with the TA Partners.
* Maintain a professional and consistent candidate experience through timely communication, clear status updates, and effective coordination from initial outreach through interview and offer stages.
* Track daily, weekly, and monthly sourcing activity and funnel performance, including source-wise pipeline, qualified submissions, time-to-first-submission, conversion rates, and source of hire.
* Prepare holistic, accurate recruitment MIS and dashboards for India, highlighting progress against hiring targets, pipeline health, offer-to-joining ratio, source effectiveness, and emerging risks.
* Monitor the impact of sourcing efforts on interview progression, offer outcomes, and candidate joining; identify trends and recommend practical improvements.
* Use sourcing technology and recruitment tools effectively; assess opportunities to improve productivity, data quality, and speed through better tool adoption and process discipline.
* Identify and escalate process gaps, delayed feedback, sourcing bottlenecks, or vendor issues to the Director – HR, with clear data and recommended actions.
* Contribute to standardising sourcing practices, reporting cadence, and operating processes so the function can scale with future hiring demand.

**What You’ll Need**
====================

* 4–6 years of experience in talent sourcing, recruitment coordination, or talent acquisition operations, preferably in a fast-paced or high-growth environment.
* Hands-on experience sourcing both technical/engineering and non-technical/business roles.
* Strong working knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean/X-ray search, applicant tracking systems (ATS), job boards, referrals, and other sourcing channels.
* Experience maintaining sourcing trackers, recruitment dashboards, and funnel metrics, with strong attention to data accuracy and reporting discipline.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with TA colleagues, hiring stakeholders, external agencies, and candidates.
* Good stakeholder-management skills and the confidence to clarify requirements, follow up on actions, and raise risks proactively.
* A strong ownership mindset: able to manage competing priorities, work independently, and drive sourcing activity without waiting for direction at every step.
* Ability to work across time zones and support U.S.-based TA counterparts and hiring teams; familiarity with U.S. hiring practices is an advantage.
* A process-improvement mindset, comfort using recruitment technology, and the ability to translate sourcing data into clear insights and actions.

**Nice to Have**
================

* Experience managing sourcing vendors, agency SLAs, and consolidated vendor reporting.
* Experience in healthcare technology, SaaS, or another technology-led organisation.
* Exposure to improving sourcing workflows, adopting new recruitment tools, or building a sourcing function.

**How Success Will Be Measured**
================================

* Sourcing activity and qualified pipeline generated daily, weekly, and monthly across multiple channels, measured against agreed hiring priorities and targets.
* Time to first qualified submission, pipeline volume, source-of-hire effectiveness, and conversion at key stages of the sourcing funnel.
* Effective use of sourcing tools and technology to improve reach, productivity, and speed of delivery.
* Quality and timeliness of recruitment MIS for India, including accurate, actionable reporting on pipeline health and hiring progress.
* Improvement in candidate progression through interviews and offers, candidate communication, and offer-to-joining outcomes, in partnership with the TA Partners.
* Accuracy and currency of candidate databases, trackers, and dashboards.
* Proactive identification and resolution of sourcing bottlenecks, vendor issues, and process gaps.

**Why This Role Matters**
=========================

This role is being added to strengthen sourcing capacity and create greater speed and predictability in hiring as ELLKAY grows. It will establish a more proactive, metrics-led sourcing operation that helps the TA team meet business demand while maintaining a consistent. candidate experience.

**Additional information**

At ELLKAY, we are committed to operating as a hybrid workplace, offering employees flexibility in how they structure their time between in-office and remote work. We recognize the significance of fostering connections, collaboration, and creativity within our office culture and its positive impact on our business. Our philosophy of operating as a hybrid workplace underscores our dedication to enabling employees to tailor work-life balance to their individual preferences. For those who do not live within 40 miles of one of our offices, we are open to considering remote work for candidates whose skills and experience strongly align with the role. While we prioritize a hybrid work environment for most roles, we understand the importance of flexibility and are open to remote work for specific positions and specialized skill sets.

The Support Analyst provides technical support to Infor customers in the United States using Infor Restaurants Point of Sale (POS) products. The role requires strong technical aptitude, excellent verbal and written English communication, strong customer service skills, and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

The successful candidate should have the technical aptitude to learn Infor Restaurants software, hardware, systems, and support processes and provide excellent remote support to customers. This position typically reports to a Manager or Team Lead.

* Provide courteous, accurate, and timely technical support to customers in accordance with established procedures.

* Provide application support for Infor Restaurants POS products.

* Maintain effective customer communication, manage expectations, and ensure a positive customer experience.

* Provide seamless remote technical assistance to US-based customers following product training.

* Strong interpersonal and customer-service skills.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize effectively, and work in a fast-paced environment.
* Working knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems, associated tools, and file structures.
* Knowledge of peripheral devices, including printers, barcode scanners, and credit card PIN pads.
* Working knowledge of networking concepts including TCP/IP, DHCP, fixed IP addresses, subnet masks, and command-line utilities.
* Working knowledge of SQL databases and query language.
* Knowledge of applications used for testing, troubleshooting, and call/case logging.
* Relevant IT certifications such as CompTIA A+, CompTIA Linux+, LPIC-1, Microsoft SQL Server, Windows Server, or Windows desktop certifications.

* Previous experience with Point of Sale (POS), restaurant, or fast-food environments and terminology.
* Technology Help Desk or equivalent field-service experience.
* Knowledge of Windows desktop and Windows Server operating systems.

-----------------

The Senior HR Recruiter owns full-cycle hiring across engineering, security, design and marketing roles in four countries. You will run searches from intake to joining, raise the bar on candidate quality, and help build a hiring process that scales.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You will work directly with hiring managers and leadership, and mentor junior recruiters as the team grows.

------------------------

* Negotiate offers and manage candidates through acceptance and joining.

* Keep the ATS accurate and up to date.
* Track and report hiring metrics: time-to-hire, source quality, offer acceptance and pipeline health.
